sentences.scenario: Tell someone what you ate yesterday.
sentences.source_note: Corrects the misplaced object in the learner's opening sentence.

sentences.english_hint: I need to go to a meeting now.
sentences.scenario: End your Chinese lesson to attend a meeting.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 一个开会 at the end of the lesson.

sentences.english_hint: He must be able to speak English.
sentences.scenario: State a required language skill for a manager.
sentences.source_note: The analysis identifies repeated confusion between 一定说 and 必须会.

sentences.chinese: 他必须有五年的工作经验。
sentences.pinyin: Tā bìxū yǒu wǔ nián de gōngzuò jīngyàn.
sentences.english_hint: He must have five years of work experience.
sentences.scenario: Explain the experience required for a manager.
sentences.source_note: The learner discussed a five-year experience requirement; the analysis supplies this drill.

sentences.english_hint: He must travel frequently for work.
sentences.scenario: Describe a job's business travel requirement.
sentences.source_note: The analysis uses this sentence to complete the three essential requirement patterns.

sentences.chinese: 如果没有工作经验，就不能当经理。
sentences.pinyin: Rúguǒ méiyǒu gōngzuò jīngyàn, jiù bù néng dāng jīnglǐ.
sentences.english_hint: Without work experience, you cannot be a manager.
sentences.scenario: Explain why experience is necessary for a management job.
sentences.source_note: Shortens the analysis's conditional correction and preserves 当经理.

sentences.chinese: 我在苹果公司工作了八年。
sentences.pinyin: Wǒ zài Píngguǒ gōngsī gōngzuò le bā nián.
sentences.english_hint: I have worked at Apple for eight years.
sentences.scenario: Tell a colleague how long you have worked at Apple.
focus: 在 + workplace + 工作了 + duration
sentences.source_note: The learner stated eight years at Apple; the analysis supplies this corrected duration drill.

sentences.chinese: 他在这个团队工作了七八年。
sentences.pinyin: Tā zài zhège tuánduì gōngzuò le qī bā nián.
sentences.english_hint: He has worked on this team for seven or eight years.
sentences.scenario: Describe your manager's approximate time on the team.
focus: 在 + workplace + 工作了 + duration
sentences.source_note: Corrects the learner's word order and retains uncertainty about seven or eight years.

sentences.english_hint: Need to travel to China for work.
sentences.scenario: Describe a China travel requirement for a job.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 要中国出差 without claiming the learner personally has an upcoming trip.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ yě zuò guo sì nián kèfú.
sentences.english_hint: I also worked in customer service for four years.
sentences.scenario: Mention your previous customer service experience.
sentences.source_note: Direct correction of the learner's description of four years in customer service.

sentences.pinyin: Nǐ kěyǐ zài shuō yí biàn ma?
sentences.scenario: Ask your teacher to repeat something during a call.
sentences.source_note: Corrects the repetition request and supports recurring requests to hear material again.

sentences.pinyin: Wǒ tīng de dào nǐ shuōhuà.
sentences.scenario: Confirm that the audio works again.
sentences.source_note: Direct correction of 我听你 after the connection problem.

sentences.english_hint: Chinese food is a little expensive.
sentences.source_note: Corrects 一点贵 and retains the learner's comment about Chinese food prices.

sentences.chinese: 对我来说，现在健康也很重要。
sentences.pinyin: Duì wǒ lái shuō, xiànzài jiànkāng yě hěn zhòngyào.
sentences.english_hint: Health is also important to me now.
sentences.scenario: Explain what matters to you at this stage of life.
sentences.source_note: Directly corrects the learner's word order without changing important to most important.
